dependencies.name: Product catalog
dependencies.purpose: Defines products, variants, pricing, publication status, media, SEO fields, and handles.
dependencies.rollback: Use product CSV/import snapshot or manually restore changed products.

dependencies.name: Collections and collection handles
dependencies.purpose: Defines customer-facing navigation groups and filter contexts.

verification.command: npm run validate:fixtures && npm run validate:filters

dependencies.rollback: Restore collection handles/rules/products from release notes and redirect map.

dependencies.name: Product and variant metafield definitions
dependencies.purpose: Stores machine specifications, compatibility, consumable attributes, warranty/support fields, and filter sources.

verification.command: npm run validate:filters && npm run validate:product-data

dependencies.rollback: Restore definitions manually from register and release notes.

dependencies.name: Shopify Search and Discovery
dependencies.purpose: Controls storefront filters, search behavior, recommendations, synonyms, and product boosts.
dependencies.rollback: Restore previous Search and Discovery filter/synonym/boost configuration manually.

dependencies.name: Header and footer navigation
dependencies.purpose: Defines storefront paths to products, collections, support pages, policies, and contact routes.
dependencies.rollback: Restore menu links from release notes/admin screenshot.
